Resolved prior issue 3 by excluding the previously overreaching CO2-uptake proxy from the core design. This is a changed decision from revise to shortlist because the main overinterpretation risks have been directly addressed and no major issue now remains."}],"overall":"Short

list E13, E15, E17, and E18. E13 improved enough to move from revise to shortlist because it now includes internal attribution controls and sharply bounded interpretation. E18 also improves from revise to shortlist because the unstable CO2-uptake proxy was removed and the card is now explicitly a descriptive bulk-covariate screen. E15 and E17 remain the strongest already-bounded candidates. Keep E14 and E16 as revise rather than reject or defer: both have genuine research value,

but each still carries substantive unresolved confounding or assignment limits that matter for the specific inferences claimed. Across the set, direct support is strongest only for staying within the P01 formulation family; most mechanistic logic remains transferable with clear limits, so the best package is a staged program of bounded descriptive comparisons first, with specialist spectroscopy only if simpler screens justify it."}
